{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Appetizers|Appetizers]]

'''Spicy chickpeas''' make a good fall-back meal using ingredients that many pantries will often have lying in a dusty corner, but that are also cheap to pick up.

==Ingredients==
*250 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] canned [[cookbook:chickpea|chickpeas]]
*2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Oil and Fat|oil]]
*2 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[cookbook:Dijon Mustard|Dijon mustard]]
*[[cookbook:Pepper|Pepper]]
*[[cookbook:Salt|Salt]]

==Procedure==
#[[Cookbook:Straining|Strain]] chickpeas and dry with a towel.
#Heat oil in large [[Cookbook:Frying Pan|skillet]]. Add chickpeas, and [[Cookbook:Sautéing|sauté]] until slightly colored, about 6 minutes.
#Add Dijon mustard and stir.
#Season with pepper and salt to taste.
